actions.text:
DEMO — pick a scenario:
1. Postpartum haemorrhage — smooth response
2. Obstructed labour, night — boatmen unresponsive, escalates
3. Eclampsia (seizures) — facility at capacity, reroutes
4. Precipitous labour — boat delayed by fuel shortage
5. Child, severe dehydration — non-maternal
6. Adult, suspected cardiac event, border-adjacent char — BSF notified
Please reply with a number 1-6.
